Job details mentioned below
 C# ASP.NET Developer
 12 months CTH
 Merrifield VA United States 22082
 

 Roles and Responsibilities: 
 Development on multiple tiers and OS environments 
 Candidate will participate perform multiple enhancements and/or new functionality to applications. 
 Strong Analysis and Design skills for multi-tier architecture - Windows OS 
 

 Minimum Requirements: 
 Four year (Bachelor degree) and a minimum of 4 years of related work experience. Will also consider 8 years of work related experience in lieu of degree. 
 Proficient in Visual Studio v10 and above. 
 At least 1 year of experience using Microsoft Asp.Net., C# 
 Experience with Microsoft SQL 
 Experience with Windows event logging 
 Must be a self-starter. 
 Must have strong analytical skills. 
 Must be able to clearly communicate (both verbally and written). 
 

 Desired Qualifications 
 Experience with Model-View-Controller (MVC) 5.0 would be a plus. 
 Experience with XML 
 Experience HTML/JavaScript. 
 Experience with Subversion 
 Experience with Microsoft Reporting Services 
 Experience with Microsoft Installation Services 

 Bachelors Degree

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
